context.body: Cosmic witness and covenant instruction converge in personal prayer.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The heavens declare God’s glory without audible speech, while the LORD’s instruction speaks clearly, restores, warns, and exposes hidden faults.
observations.label: Creation and instruction disclose God differently: action

observations.body: The speaker moves from observing creation to desiring cleansed words and thoughts.
observations.label: Creation and instruction disclose God differently: response

observations.body: declare · no speech · law · hidden faults

payload.posture: Read Psalm 19:1–14 as prayer and wisdom evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Creation’s witness is real in the poem but does not supply the same content as the named instruction.
